svg.title: F07-1 Filled ITP sheet: MV cable installation and testing, ITP-ELE-MV-002 rev 1 (extract)
svg.text: ITP-ELE-MV-002 rev 1, 14 May 2026, review code B
ES-02 QC engineer; GC-A QA/QC manager; Engineer; CxM reviewed
type, length, no damage, caps sealed
Inspect duct and tray route before pull
mandrel passed; bends at min. radius
First termination of each kit type
all lines released; punch A, B closed

Hold point (H): work stops until a written release is signed on the IR. Witness point (W): the work proceeds after the notice period if the party does not attend; the IR records "notified, not attended".
Review point (R): the record is reviewed within 5 working days while work continues. Surveillance (S): sampled without notice, at least 10 % of items per week per discipline on MSC-1.
F07-1 Filled ITP sheet: MV cable installation and testing, ITP-ELE-MV-002 rev 1 (extract)
building B2 · 20 kV feeders · 3 × 1C 630 mm² Cu XLPE · codes per party: P perform, H hold, W witness, R review, S surveillance
• Lines 3.4 (before duct sealing) and 5.2 (VLF before energisation) are hold points; line 6.3 "Ready for L3" is held by the GC, the Engineer and the CxM.
• Test values are copied from the specification and the cited table (IEEE 400.2, NETA ATS-2025 Table 100.6, IEC 60229) and confirmed before approval.
